title: Aqd Ummul Banee'n se Ali ne Kiya
body:
Moula Abbas a.s
Aqd ummul bani se Ali ne kiya
Jis ki khatir wo shere jiyaan aa gaya
Bol uthe murtaza ye to Abbas hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere shabbir ka qadardaan aa gaya
Khush hain hasnain-o-Ummul Baneen-o-Ali
Khuld se fatema ne bhi di tehniyat
Umme kulsum-o-Zainab huyeen sajda rez
<<DIVIDER>>
Unke sar par ik aur saayebaan aa gaya
Warise hamza-o-jafaro-murtaza
Ta qayamat alamdar-e-fauje khuda
Azm-o-zabt-o-shaja'at ita'at wafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Khidmate isteqamat nishaan aa gaya
Ambiyaa ausiyaa auliyaa
Sab ka daro madar-e-baqa Karbala
Karbala jis ki muddat se thi muntazar
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo mueen-e-shahe be kasaan aa gaya
Dastgiri karega jo har ek ki
Bawajude ke honge qalam uske haath
Ek laqab jiska babul hawaej bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo mutiye imam-e-zamaan aa gaya
Jeete ji wo raha bhooka pyasa magar
Uske sadqe pa palte hain jinn-o-bashar
Khadime khaas jannat ke Sardar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Abde saleh jawane jinaa aa gaya
Alqama ab bhi hai jiske zere qadam
Har jagah jiska lehra raha hai alam
Garb uske qadam sharq jiski jabeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Raunaq-e-mehfile kun fakaan aa gaya
Rok sakta hai nazron se lashkar ko jo
Chheen sakta hai ghaat ek naize se wo
Jisko baade shahdat bhi ghaazi kahein
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo jawano jareen pehelawaan aa gaya
Fatema ki amaanat samjh kar mujhe
Apni aagosh mein qabr ne rakh liya
Mujh se milne ko aaye Ali jab suna
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere Abbas ka mad'ha khwaan aa gaya
Sibte Jafar jo tha aam sa aadmi
Karte karte sanaye nabi-o-Ali
Saya-e-parcham-e-maula Abbas ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalte chalte kahaan se kahaan aa gaya
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
